import sys
import os
import json
import re
from datetime import datetime

def parse_date(date_str):
    if not date_str:
        return None
    # Try various formats found in the text
    formats = [
        "%d %b %Y",      # 11th Jul 2026 -> 11 Jul 2026
        "%d %B %Y",      # February 2nd, 2026 -> 02 February 2026 (needs cleaning)
        "%d %b, %Y",     # May 30th, 2026
        "%B %d, %Y",     # March 14th, 2026
        "%d %B, %Y",     # February 24th, 2026
        "%d %b %Y",      # 25th Jan 2026
        "%d %B %Y",      # 25 January 2026
        "%Y-%m-%d"
    ]
    
    # Clean common suffixes like 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 11th, etc.
    cleaned = re.sub(r'(\d+)(st|nd|rd|th)', r'\1', date_str)
    # Remove commas for easier parsing
    cleaned = cleaned.replace(',', '')
    
    for fmt in formats:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(cleaned, fmt)
        except ValueError:
            continue
    return None

    if not amt_str:
